official_source.title: FIFA Futsal Laws of the Game 2025-26
official_source.version_label: 2025-26; effective from 5 September 2025; approved by the Bureau of the Council

notes: Law 1 international pitch length 38-42 m / width 20-25 m; goals 3 m x 2 m; Law 3 five players max (one goalkeeper), minimum three to start/resume, max nine substitutes in official competitions; Law 7 two equal periods of 20 minutes playing time; Law 10 goal scored = whole of ball over goal line; extra time two equal periods not exceeding five minutes each when competition rules require a winner. Index: https://www.fifa.com/en/futsal-laws-of-the-game
